title: Appeal - zCombo - Ban Evasion

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello zCombo,

You have just admitted in your own appeal that you ban evaded, your brother has also told me so. By making a new account and coming on you are breaking one of the Avicus Rules listed under Section A, Rule 8. Regardless of any good intentions, you broke the rules and you must now face the consequences. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
